quizzes.description: Answer the question , You only have 1 good answer . Good LUCK

quiz_questions.question_text: Which woman below would be classified as a woman in active labor?
quiz_questions.options_json: ["a) Mrs. A with cervix dilated 3 cm and painful, irregular contractions","b) Mrs. B. with cervix dilated 4 cms and painful contractions every 3 minutes","c) Mrs. C. with cervix dilated 5 cms and painful contractions every 3 minutes"]

quiz_questions.question_text: How often should the fetal heart rate be checked and recorded during active phase of the 1st stage of labor?
quiz_questions.options_json: ["a) Every 15 minutes","b) Every 30 minutes","c) Every 60 minutes"]

quiz_questions.question_text: When can you wash your hands with alcohol-based rub rather than soap and water?
quiz_questions.options_json: ["a) If hands are not visibly soiled","b) If hands are visibly soiled","c) Any time, regardless of activity or soil"]

quiz_questions.question_text: Which of the following has been shown to decrease complications at birth?
quiz_questions.options_json: ["a) Performing a vaginal examination every two hours","b) Routinely augmenting labor to shorten the first stage","c) Performing artificial rupture of membranes during labor to assess the color of the","amniotic fluid","d) Allowing the woman to have a companion of her choice with her during labor and","birth"]
